method: Built-in image generation with explicit style reference to the existing game illustrations; generated raster assets, not human drawings.

prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Image 1 is the EXISTING GAME ART STYLE reference. Image 2 is the new apartment scene atlas to revise. The user explicitly needs continuity with image 1: make image 2 look like it belongs to exactly the same game and was drawn by the same pixel illustrator. Match image 1's handcrafted low resolution pixel clusters, stepped angular contours, flat discrete shaded color regions, limited dusty lavender/navy/gray palette, tiny warm amber lights, simple readable architectural shapes. Remove the realistic grain, dirty watercolor photography appearance and extremely detailed textures of image 2. No paper texture, no airbrushing, no glossy light. Preserve the four scenes and precise 2x2 grid from image 2: top left old Korean apartment rain entrance with management booth; top right narrow apartment corridor with cracked open door and subtle wrong shadow; bottom left flooded basement with old hanging doorframes and empty coat; bottom right rooftop water tank/standing doorframe at gray dawn. Overall atlas aspect ratio 16:9, four equal widescreen panels filling quadrants, no gutters or borders. Like reference game art, horror should come from composition and emptiness, not overt monsters or gore. No text, numerals, labels or UI. Do not copy the hotel subjects; only match its drawing style.
